<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a halide (the acyl‑chloride Cl) and form an amide carbonyl, which matches the Friedel‑Crafts‑type acylation described. This should return a template whose application to the target molecule yields the correct precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2Cl)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
